## Change
Apply the independently accepted priority-string corrections: 23 German and 8 Spanish (es-ES). The application diff contains only two catalogues, two compact current-wording fixtures and two focused host test modules.

The corrections clarify storage/recovery and image-metadata errors, retain complete memory-warning safeguards, improve accessibility instructions, fix German pixel-unit composition and Spanish selected-tool grammatical agreement, and use German VG/HG labels.

## Scope preserved
- German: four stylistic proposals remain unchanged; all seven original uncertain rows remain held.
- Spanish: FG/BG and palette uncertainty remain held; the Save alias stays `@string/ui_save`.
- Thirty corrected entries have direct static consumers; the Spanish touchscreen wording remains wording-only.
- No whole-language, native-speaker, device, layout or TalkBack certification. No PR56 changes.

## Compact review and test receipt
- Exact reviewed base and unchanged develop at integration: `c86ecfd707cd88e6656010a800cb6048ed867d4e`.
- Source head: `810c36301be81b72e1da91a2b887e1d830517808`; tree: `1b41f6196a897403cee2428bebb7901cdc06f018`.
- All 1,153 base files and modes verified against Git objects; all 1,157 final remote files and modes match the local final tree. Exactly six files differ.
- Full normal host suite: 777 tests passed. The optimized full run executed 777 tests and reported three 15-second timeout errors in unchanged `test_vertical_locale_matrix.MatrixShellTest.test_each_shard_runs_once_with_normal_lifecycle_even_after_a_first_failure` API30 subcases. The isolated optimized rerun of the unchanged harness test passed in 10.370 seconds with the original 15-second subcase watchdog. The initial optimized aggregate remains recorded as failed; no deadlines or tests were relaxed.
- Focused normal and optimized suites: 17 tests passed in each mode. Both complete catalogue checks pass. Patch/unchanged-byte checks and old-value negative controls pass.
- Local Android compile, lint, JVM/device/layout/TalkBack stages have not run; exact-head hosted checks remain required.

Original German review: 341 entries, with its original counts unchanged (340 new pair reviews and one prior receipt reused); SHA-256 `f9ace82a668be217e3f6cff2ea217733e32bdf1c0d8a90c0988e5747a1326028`.

Spanish original review bytes remain unavailable. The separately identified 341-entry reconstruction has SHA-256 `51edaa03d87222275d5e7a9b10e5fd618c6589dd0b43247dfecd4567864a55e2`; reconstruction and implementation receive no new linguistic-review credit. Its original acceptance counts and wording-only limits are retained.

Bulk historical review records and logs are excluded from the application tree.

pr110.head: eb84700ac34996ae054b7eb9def28c5d1ff0d31b
pr110.body:
## Scope

Correct 30 source-backed resource values: Russian (4), European Portuguese (10), Italian (7), French (2), and Dutch (7). This is a bounded wording correction, not whole-language acceptance or installed-UI verification.

- Russian: clarify bitmap-memory allocation, use number-neutral pixel counts, and make category-selection descriptions agree with a fixed noun.
- European Portuguese: preserve language-maintenance/English-fallback and canvas-anchor semantics; correct selected-tool agreement, pinch guidance, units, and selection/none labels.
- Italian: fix save/export destination and recovery-copy wording, language fallback, category-selection agreement, and pinch guidance.
- French: use “Outil sélectionné” before the selected tool so both feminine and masculine tool names produce grammatical accessibility/tooltip text.
- Dutch: distinguish ellipse drawing from selection; name memory allocation and incomplete encoding correctly; preserve maintenance/English fallback; use number-neutral counts and lowercase units in composed descriptions.

The seven complete Dutch before/after values and their actual consumers were independently assessed before inclusion. Existing palette/Main/colour-swap uncertainties are unchanged. Other held terminology and rejected style-only candidates remain unchanged. No new PR #56 credit is claimed, and its held branch/tracker is untouched. German/Spanish PR #109 is separate and is not duplicated here.

## Regression coverage

Four compact current-wording fixtures plus three host test modules cover the Russian/Portuguese, Italian, and Dutch corrections: typed placeholders, Android string syntax, complete values, source consumers, preserved safety clauses and held wording, and negative/mutation controls.

Two French Robolectric methods exercise the real ToolCategoryButton across all configured category/tool combinations, expansion states and disclosure orientations, plus selection refresh of accessibility and tooltip text. They are authored here; their execution awaits hosted JVM checks.

## Verification

- Base: `c86ecfd707cd88e6656010a800cb6048ed867d4e`; current develop rechecked before publication.
- All 1,153 base files and executable modes checked. Reverse application of all four patches exactly reproduces base blobs. The complete remote tree was compared by path/type/blob/mode: 1,161 leaves, exactly 5 modified resource files and 8 additions. No cache files, bulky audit archives, workflow edits, deletions or unrelated changes.
- Full normal host suite: **794 tests passed in 220.110s**, using `python3 -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' -v`.
- Focused tests: **34 passed normally and under Python -O** (12 Russian/Portuguese, 9 Italian, 13 Dutch).
- Full optimized host suite: **794 tests passed in 234.045s**, using `python3 -O -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py'`. All 1,161 expected file blobs/modes were rechecked unchanged after both complete suites.
- AAPT2 2.19-11948202: all five changed resource catalogues compile.
- Host Java formatter: **32/32** French category/tool-state cases pass; Dutch five count boundaries, typed warning arguments, and both composed unit labels pass.
- Earlier Russian/Portuguese-only full run: 772 tests with three unchanged 10-second CLI timeouts. Those original failures remain preserved; the three isolated cases then passed, followed by an unchanged 772-test retry. They are separate historical attempts, not this combined 794-test pass.
- Android Gradle/JVM (including the two new French methods), lint, APK/source/signature and installed API35 checks have not run locally: no Android SDK/Gradle distribution is available. The existing PR workflow supplies these asynchronous checks. No device, layout/glyph-clipping, TalkBack or native-speaker certification is claimed.
